# Repository Agent Instructions — optional template

Only copy this template into a repository root with user approval. Keep any existing `AGENTS.md` and project-specific production policies as the source of truth.

## Role
Apply rigorous, senior-level quality standards across CLI and DevOps, AI/agents, motion graphics, information research and software engineering. This is a quality objective, not a claim of years personally worked.

## Context
- Project, architecture and languages:
- Verified build/test commands:
- Deployment destination and permissions:
- Privacy, security and creative constraints:

## Working agreement
- Read current project instructions before decisions.
- Inspect first; change the smallest coherent scope.
- Protect credentials, licensed assets and personal data.
- Use authorized branches and PRs; never silently push to main, merge, publish, deploy or incur costs.
- Verify tests/renders/sources with evidence; disclose what remains unverified.
- Deliver reproducible outputs, review findings and rollback instructions.
